header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH KARACHI
Date Order with signature(s) of Judge(s)
Mr. Saith Ali, Advocate for the petitioner.
1. Learned counsel for the petitioner pleads urgency. Urgency granted.
body: 2. Through this application under Order XXIII Rule 1(2) read with Section 151 CPC, the petitioner has sought withdrawal of petition. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that under instructions he wishes to withdraw the instant petition. Accordingly, the listed application is allowed and this petition is dismissed as withdrawn along with pending applications.
JUDGE HEAD OF CONST. BENCHES JUDGE Azeem
